releases.notes:
## ElytraWEEE 1.2.0 — the best version yet 🪂

The smoothest elytra experience for Minecraft 26.1.2.

### ✈️ Instant flight on deploy
Jump with a firework (single **or** double jump) and you start gliding **immediately** — no more equipping the elytra and then having to tap jump again.

### 🛡️ Smarter, safer swap-back
- Took off wearing a chestplate? It comes back on when you land and stop holding a firework.
- Took off wearing nothing? The elytra returns to the **exact slot it came from** (hotbar included).
- Inventory full? The elytra simply stays on — **nothing is ever dropped**.
- The mod **only** manages an elytra it deployed for flight. Put one on yourself, manually or with the fast-swap key, and it leaves your gear alone.

### 🗡️ Fast swap + auto re-glide (mace PvP)
Flip elytra ⇄ chestplate instantly with a keybind, **even mid-air**. Swap to chestplate, hit, swap back — and you **keep gliding automatically** (no re-jump). Toggle, on by default.

### 🎛️ Cleaner settings
Reorganised tabs (General, Auto-Deploy, Swap-Back, Fast Swap, Info) with compact, easy-to-read tooltips.

---

**Requires:** Fabric API · Cloth Config · Mod Menu (optional). Client-only — works on servers.

releases.notes:
## ElytraWEEE 1.1.0

New features and fixes for Minecraft 26.1.2 (Fabric, client-only).

### Jump → firework grace window
Jumping no longer has to be perfectly synced with holding a firework. Jump first, then grab a firework within ~0.5s (configurable, works in both Single and Double jump modes) and the elytra still deploys. Toggle and window length live under **Auto-Deploy**.

### Fast-swap keybind (mace PvP)
A keybind that instantly toggles between your elytra and chestplate — **including mid-air**, unlike the automatic ground-only swap-back. Reuses the safe no-drop swap routines; if you have no chestplate it keeps the elytra on (never bares your chest). Works even with auto-deploy disabled, and briefly suppresses the auto swap-back so a ground swap is not undone.

### Dedicated keybinds
Three keybinds under their own **ElytraWEEE** category in *Options → Controls*, all **unbound by default**:
- **Fast swap** — toggle elytra/chestplate instantly (also mid-air)
- **Toggle on/off** — flip the master switch (action-bar status message)
- **Open settings** — open the config screen in-game

### Reorganized settings
The config screen is now split into focused tabs: **General, Auto-Deploy, Swap-Back, Fast Swap, Info**.

Existing `config/elytraweee.json` files upgrade automatically.
